author: The Critical Drinker
description:
She-Hulk was one of the biggest disasters in Marvel history, but the story of what was going on behind the scenes and how it killed showrunner Jessica Gau's career almost overnight, is something we only learned about recently. 

Book your tickets for Critical Drinker fan meetup in London, September 10th: https://www.tickettailor.com/events/gradualupgradeproductions/2331646
title: She-Hulk - The Show That Literally Killed Careers
